question: A vector is represented by the directed line segment from $P(-2,1,4)$ to $Q(3,-3,10)$.(a) Determine the scalar components of $\overrightarrow{PQ}$.(b) Write its vector components along the coordinate axes.(c) Reconstruct $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ using its vector components and calculate its magnitude.
explanation: (a)The vector from $P$ to $Q$ is obtained by subtracting the coordinates of $P$ from the corresponding coordinates of $Q$.`\overrightarrow{PQ}=[3-(-2)]\hat{i}+(-3-1)\hat{j}+(10-4)\hat{k}\overrightarrow{PQ}=5\hat{i}-4\hat{j}+6\hat{k}`Therefore, its scalar components are $5$, $-4$ and $6$.(b)The vector component along the $x$-axis is $5\hat{i}$.The vector component along the $y$-axis is $-4\hat{j}$.The vector component along the $z$-axis is $6\hat{k}$.Final ResultThe vector components are $5\hat{i}$, $-4\hat{j}$ and $6\hat{k}$.(c)Adding the vector components,`5\hat{i}+(-4\hat{j})+6\hat{k}=5\hat{i}-4\hat{j}+6\hat{k}`Thus, the reconstructed vector is $\overrightarrow{PQ}=5\hat{i}-4\hat{j}+6\hat{k}$. Its magnitude is`|\overrightarrow{PQ}|=\sqrt{5^2+(-4)^2+6^2}|\overrightarrow{PQ}|=\sqrt{25+16+36}=\sqrt{77}`
